# A residual asked for on an account the book does not hold.
#
# 100 USD that cost 135.00 CAD, sold for 139.00 CAD, with the 4.00 CAD
# between them written to `Income:No Such Gain`. No account by that name was
# opened, so there is nowhere to book the residual.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the transaction.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_residual_split.py.
2026-03-01 * "Sell 100 USD to an account nobody opened"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "-135.00"
	Assets:Bank 139.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "139.00"
	Income:No Such Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
